title: Thermomix Banana Bread
description: Verified ingredients, general method. The amounts are from Cookidoo AU; the exact steps are subscription-gated.

confidence.note: Verified ingredients, general method. The amounts are from Cookidoo AU; the exact steps are subscription-gated.

methodLabel: General method (not the official Cookidoo steps)

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 180°C and line a loaf tin with baking paper.
Add the bananas ({{bananas}}) to the bowl and mash 10 sec / Speed 4. Scrape down.
Add the sugar ({{sugar}}), eggs ({{eggs}}), buttermilk ({{buttermilk}}) and vanilla ({{vanilla}}). Mix 15 sec / Speed 4.
Add the flour ({{flour}}), baking powder ({{baking-powder}}), bicarbonate of soda ({{bicarb}}) and salt ({{salt}}). Mix 15 sec / Speed 4 until just combined. Do not overmix or the loaf turns dense.
Pour into the lined tin and bake 45–50 minutes, until a skewer comes out clean.
Cool in the tin 10 minutes, then turn out onto a rack to cool fully before slicing.

notes.title: Swaps and add-ins
notes.text: Raw sugar works 1:1 with a little more caramel depth. Oat milk replaces the buttermilk at the same quantity. Using self-raising flour? Omit the bicarbonate of soda. For coconut and cranberry, fold a handful of each through and scatter extra coconut on top. For chocolate, swirl a cocoa-sugar paste through or replace 30–40g of flour with cocoa.

notes.title: Storage
notes.text: A few days in a bread box once fully cool, up to a week wrapped in the fridge, or sliced and frozen up to 3 months. Toasting from frozen with butter is excellent.
